about_the_game:
The Luminleaf Chronicles demo includes the following content:

  • Choose one of four valiant characters and jump into battle, either alone or with friends. Experience the thrilling rush of mowing down a relentless tide of enemies.

  • Challenge three powerful bosses across a stage featuring nine total waves. Each wave intensifies, forcing you to adapt and fight against increasingly stronger foes.

  • Defend against a constant onslaught of monsters, then claim the spoils of victory to make your character even more powerful.

  • Enjoy about 30 minutes of core combat with your friends. Stay tuned for more characters and richer content in the full version!

The Luminleaf Chronicles demo features the following gameplay content:

  • Defeat powerful bosses and absorb their strength to enhance your unique skills. Master a more powerful skill combination to stand against endless threats.

  • Collect mystical gems to boost your character's stats. Forge your own growth strategy, whether it's maximizing your skill damage or building an unbreakable defense.

  • Experience combat across a special stage with nine escalating waves. Fight your way through hordes of monsters and challenge the ultimate boss waiting at the final gate. This journey will prepare you for the greater dangers that await in the full version.

  • Enjoy about 30 minutes of gameplay. Look forward to even more content in the full version!

“Luminleaf Chronicles” is a game that combines the survival/adventure/defense/roguelike genres that can be enjoyed alone or with up to four people. Acquire EPIC items, upgrade your skills, and fight against demons who want to destroy the World Tree at any cost in the sequentially generated in-game world!

The demons must be captured during the day or else the stronger demons will destroy Lumicantl. At night, you must defeat powerful demons in the dark. As time passes, Kairos, the king of demons, grows closer to Lumicantl. As a cat girl, you must come up with a strategy to defeat Kairos.

Catch demons, acquire equipment, find forgotten knowledge, and upgrade your skills! Develop your own strategy and protect this world tree by catching increasingly powerful demons as quickly as possible!

Defeating Kairos requires solid judgment, focus, and great teamwork. We can rescue each other from danger! Survive until the end, defeat the boss together, and complete the achievement!

With each new start, choose from a variety of characters, make the most of the items and upgrades you discover, and devise new strategies to defeat them quickly!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.00 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is a local multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players that combines elements of survival, adventure, and roguelike genres. Acquire items, upgrade your skills, and defeat the continuously appearing bosses to survive tooth and nail in the game world, ultimately face the Skeleton King!
